content: {"action":"write_off","reasoning":"CO-97 establishes that CPT 93271 is bundled into another paid service and is not separately payable, so resubmission would not correct the denial and risks a duplicate-claim denial. Prior authorization is not required, retro-authorization is unavailable, and another medical-necessity review would not overcome a bundling determination. The denied contractual balance cannot properly be shifted to the patient, so it should be written off."}
